question.text: A circle <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> has radius <math><mn>2</mn></math> units and a circle <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> has radius <math><mn>3</mn></math> units.
